task.name: Strike_camp_fence
task.when: During Strike after the boundary is no longer needed for traffic control

step.action: Remove each fence section in the printed reverse order.
Remove every fence anchor and ground fastener.
Put every connection and anchor in the fence hardware bin.
Bundle and secure fence sections in their transport group.

passWhen.criterion: Every fence section, connection, anchor, and ground fastener is accounted for and packed.
The former fence line is clear and MOOP-free.
